verses.text: How terrible for those who go down to Egypt for help, who depend on horses, who trust in their many chariots and in their very strong horsemen, but do not look to the Holy One of Israel or ask the LORD for help!
Yet he too is wise. He can bring disaster, and he does not take back his words. He will rise up against the family of evildoers and against those who help people who do wrong.

The Egyptians are only humans, not God. Their horses are only flesh, not spirit. When the LORD stretches out his hand, the helper will stumble, and the one being helped will fall. They will all die together.

For this is what the LORD says to me: "When a lion, a young lion, growls over the animal it has caught, and a whole crowd of shepherds is called out against it, it is not frightened by their shouts or troubled by their noise. In the same way the LORD of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its hill.
Like birds flying over their nests, the LORD of Armies will protect Jerusalem. He will shield it and rescue it. He will pass over it and save it."
People of Israel, turn back to the one you have rebelled against so terribly.
For on that day every one of you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, the sinful idols your hands have made.
"Assyria will fall by a sword, but not a human sword. A sword not made by people will destroy them. They will run from the sword, and their young men will be made to do forced labor.
Their stronghold will fall because of terror, and their commanders will panic at the sight of the battle flag," says the LORD, whose fire is in Zion and whose furnace is in Jerusalem.
